{"notes": "Visit 2 (ending 2:30). Still don't know who placed which domino; no hands labeled. Picture: the single dark chain grew from ~11 to ~30 dominoes, all connected, running from START through the tail bend and out to ~(12.5,4.5), which looks like the nose. Tail bend looks clean. No bottom line is visible, and no pale (broken) dominoes. 7.5 min left.

Priya: Kept coordinating and said she's working the top line toward the nose. The chain's progress fits that, but I didn't see her place anything. She explained that the bottom line hangs off the nose, so it can't start until her line arrives. That clears up why it's absent and shows she understands the dependency. She also reassigned Maya to the tail end and asked Leo to watch the tail bend. Strong leadership and communication. One slip: told Tom to keep going on the bottom line, which doesn't match what's on the table.

Tom: Said he's staying off the bottom line because Maya's on it, and is checking joins and will look at the nose. Good collaboration, but his claim about Maya isn't borne out: no bottom line exists. Unclear whether he's confused or covering. Doing QA and not building. Ask him what he's actually done.

Leo: Silent this visit. Was asked to watch the tail bend and it looks fine, but I didn't see him act. Still all talk, no observed execution.

Maya: Still unobserved. Tom says she's on the bottom line, but nothing visible supports it. Probably waiting for the top line to reach the nose, which would be reasonable. Ask her privately what she's doing. Don't judge yet.

Next visit: check the bottom line has started at the nose, and who builds it."}
